items.html:
A talented aggressive opening batsman and wicketkeeper, Dane Cleaver was named in New Zealand's squad for the Under-19 World Cup in 2010. His cousin, Kane Williamson, captained the team at the 2008 event.
Cricinfo staff January 2010
